newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SPEED SKATING-DUTCH DEAL ANOTHER BLOW TO NIEMANN.
newsitem.headline: SPEED SKATING-DUTCH DEAL ANOTHER BLOW TO NIEMANN.

text.p: skating world champion Gunda Niemann admitted she was suffering
a crisis after losing another race to young Dutchwoman Tonny de
Jong at the second World Cup event of the season on Sunday.
"I don't know exactly what I'm doing wrong. First
I'll have to refind my old form," said Niemann, who was
overtaken on the final lap of the 1,500 metres by de Jong.
De Jong was thrilled with her winning time of two minutes
3.24 seconds but was not convinced that her big rival was on the
wane. "No doubt she'll come back," said de Jong, who beat world
record holder Niemann into third place over 3,000 metres on
